Existing browser open/save/autosave/recovery policies remain unchanged.

The old host fatal-decoder/undeclared-UTF8 gate is removed. Matching real local/CEN raw malformed bytes retain source replacement behavior and BMP non-ASCII paths without that bit load normally; no codepage guessing or private decoder is introduced.

ZIP32/ZIP64 END/locator/signature/disk/count/signed arithmetic/record consistency and ordered Zip64/Unicode/unknown extras retain source conditions, lvalue writes and diagnostics. MemoryInputStream const sal_Int8 pointer binding now also borrows actual signed/unsigned typed byte storage without an archive-sized address provider. CEN checks record count/size, STORE consistency and eagerly applies the consumed LOC name/flag/extra/duplicated-value checks; actual payload CRC/inflate remains on read. Committed unmodified testTdf163341 ZIP64 and normal Unicode ODT/DOCX rejection cases exercise the real catalog; recovery/service factories are not fabricated. The existing flat byte/catalog/host-error/resource boundary remains explicit. Full native descriptor/overlap/hole/FAT/case-insensitive/recovery/ZipEntry/ZipOutputStream/package/storage/model/filter/Worker/UI acceptance and physical pointer/ABI/thread/allocation guarantees are unverified or unfinished. CALC-505..508 and WRITER436..439 retain source surprises and invalid-view limitations. Existing browser recovery/open/save/autosave choices remain unchanged.

Original readLOC_Impl uses genuine ByteGrabber/MemoryByteGrabber owners for header, reused zero-initialized name/extra vectors, optional-signature 32/64-bit data descriptors, Excel version45 fallback and nonzero duplicated-field comparisons. Source readCEN partitions occupied extents, rejects overlaps/holes with original diagnostics and skips FAT-compatible empty directory entries after consuming their extents. Actual generated ZipIOException derives from IOException with the correct parent type. A committed unchanged dd-deflated.docx exercises original normal QA rejection. Flat byte/catalog/resource/host-error boundaries remain explicit; native case-insensitive modes, created-entry/recovery/service/package/ZipEntry/output/model/filter/Worker/UI graphs and physical pointer/ABI/allocation/thread guarantees remain unverified or unfinished. Browser open/save/autosave/recovery choices are unchanged.

Original ZipFile Checks modes retain exact duplicate rejection, ASCII-only case collisions and the first retained entry decision for TryCheckInsensitive, including empty mimetype AutoCorrect behavior after FAT-directory filtering. OOXML ZipStorage selects CheckInsensitive; Writer/Calc ODF byte entry points select TryCheckInsensitive, matching ZipPackage StorageFormat routing. The actual OUString lowercase path delegates to rtl_uString_newToAsciiLowerCase and original newReplaceChars allocation/assign/release logic with reused native CaseReplace and SAL character helpers. Unchanged strings alias data; conversions preserve UTF16/embedded-zero/non-ASCII units and release old destination after copying. No Unicode locale folding, path normalization or fake model/storage/service owner is introduced. Flat transport/resource/error boundaries and incomplete native package/storage/output/model/filter/Worker/UI acceptance remain explicit; physical pointer/ABI/allocator/thread guarantees remain unverified.

stackDivergence.rationale: Original directory/extra mechanisms use genuine native byte/Reference/exception values, while the existing flat archive-byte entry projection and host Error envelope remain a transport boundary rather than an XStorage/ZipPackage service. Native structural failures are captured as primitive type/message causes and destroyed once before the host error is thrown; no fake model/parent/query/provider is introduced.
